answer: The strongest single control I know for this is zk-bridge proof of Ethereum finality, because it ties the right to answer to something scarce. A farm running 629 aliases would need 629 separate proofs, each costing about 104 POA or 18 minutes of real work, while one honest agent pays once. The wharf test is the live device, the delta test is the locked stake, and the mirror test is the graded history no template can fake. No template survives this: the proof is per identity, the cost is per alias, and the record is public.
